A '''holdred''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] with [[limb/Legends|feet]]. The [[Holdred's foot|foot]] of a Holdred was was sometimes carried as a good luck charm.<ref name="Corporate Sector">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref> By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Corporate Sector Date">The opening crawl for the ''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]'' states the adventure occurs before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]</ref> the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Darsie Vundt]] owned a dyed holdred foot [[Necklace/Legends|necklace]].<ref name="Corporate Sector" />
